summary: Iteration 2 testing (invite auto-add + weekly digest + web push + regressions). Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases pass (test_iteration2.py) covering POST /api/friends/request-by-username (success + 404 + duplicate no-400 regression), POST /api/admin/trigger-weekly-digest (admin gate + end-to-end notification creation with a friend voy on an event within 7 days), and /api/push/{vapid-public-key,status,subscribe,unsubscribe} auth + persistence. Full previous suite still passes 16/16, so 26/26 backend. Frontend Playwright: /login?add=marta shows invite-banner naming @marta, forces register tab, stores localStorage qv_pending_add=marta. Registering a fresh user via UI triggers auto friend-request to marta (verified via marta's notifications API) and toast 'Solicitud de amistad enviada a @marta' appears; qv_pending_add is removed after processing. Existing-user LOGIN via /login?add=bob also auto-fires the request (bob got friend_request notification) and clears qv_pending_add. Profile page renders push-toggle-btn 'Activar avisos en el móvil' when accessed at /profile; clicking it (in headless incognito Chromium where Push API is unavailable) shows an error toast and does NOT crash the app. GET /api/push/status returns {subscribed:false} and endpoint requires auth (401 unauth). Duplicate-friend-request regression fully verified via backend (returns 200 with status=accepted instead of 400).

issues: Invite banner shows a decorative '@' avatar circle immediately followed by '@marta' text — reads as '@@marta' when extracting text (visually two separate elements). Purely cosmetic; consider removing the leading '@' from the avatar or using just an icon.

action_items: OPTIONAL cosmetic: invite-banner avatar circle contains a literal '@' that visually duplicates with the '@username' text right after it — swap for an icon or remove the '@' from the badge.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 997 lines (>700 threshold) — split into routers (auth, events, friends, admin, notifications, push, digest) is even more urgent.

generate_weekly_digest() iterates all interests per user and re-fetches each event and each friend inside the loop — O(users * interests * 2). Fine for MVP but should batch-fetch events/users once for larger datasets.
push_to_user() uses asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget inside create_notification — silent failures. Consider logging exceptions from the background task via a done_callback.

do_friend_request now returns {'status':'accepted'} idempotently on duplicates — good regression fix. Consider still returning a hint field like already_friends:true so the UI can suppress the 'solicitud enviada' toast when appropriate.
/api/push/vapid-public-key is unauthenticated (OK — public key is not sensitive), but consider caching header to avoid repeated fetches.
Login.js invite-banner: the leading '@' circle+text produces visual duplication ('@ @marta').

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (real push delivery not testable in headless per task spec)

test_credentials: Admin admin@quienva.app / QuienVa2026! confirmed working. marta/bob users auto-created by test where absent.
